metadata.title: Guidelines for Application to Conduct Clinical Trials in Tanzania (TMDA), TMDA/DMC/CTP/G/001
metadata.edition: Rev. 04, March 2020 (published_on 1 March 2020 is a placeholder day) · 1.14.3 fatal or life-threatening SAEs and SUSARs 24 hours + 7 calendar days; others 14 calendar days
metadata.legal_basis: TMDA guideline under the Clinical Trials Control Regulations 2013; the regulations prevail.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
